svg.title: Fixed-end moments for a uniform load and an off-centre point load
svg.desc: Fixed ends hold the beam level, so hogging moments appear at the supports. A uniform load gives wL squared/12 at each end and wL squared/24 at mid-span. A point load W at a from A and b from B gives Wab squared/L squared at A and W a squared b/L squared at B, larger at the nearer end.

g.text: point load at a from A
Central load: WL/8 at each end
